name: prompt-library-plugin
description: Manage Image Prompt Library as a public platform for discovering, learning, customizing, and reusing AI prompts through its connected MCP.

interface.longDescription: Editorial and content management for Image Prompt Library. Research, develop, curate, maintain, and publish useful, reusable AI prompt templates and educational content through the connected MCP, following specialized skills.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create and publish one reusable image prompt template in Image Prompt Library.
